title: An editable system role's three-dot menu shows View Permissions and no Delete
preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
steps:
1. Open the three-dot menu on an editable system role (for example Administrator or Service Manager).
  2. List the menu options.
expected:
The menu has no Delete option (system roles cannot be deleted).

(Note: the build has a Duplicate Role feature — confirm live whether Duplicate appears in this menu; the older 'no Duplicate' expectation may be out of date.)
